title: Malaysia KPKT TEDUH Property Developer Scraper Input

maxPages.title: Max API Pages to Fetch (30 Developers per Page)
maxPages.description: Number of pages to fetch from KPKT TEDUH /api/developer-swasta endpoint (1 page = 30 developers & all their licensed housing projects; 219 pages = full ~6,545 developers).

maxItems.title: Max Project Records to Output
maxItems.description: Maximum number of developer-project records to push to the dataset (Free-tier Apify runs are capped at 25 results).

searchKeyword.title: Optional Developer / Project Filter Keyword
searchKeyword.description: Optional keyword to filter developer name or state (leave empty for all).
